title: Intel strongest bull countercase and funded external-wafer diagnostic
status: Substantive bull-countercase completed; root owns final hour synthesis and confidence.

cohort_diagnostic_policy.purpose: A normalized external-wafer revenue cohort, not an adopted named-customer forecast or probability estimate. Scale linearly only after computing the same unit case. No inputs selected to close equity gap.
cohort_diagnostic_policy.normalization: 1B annual manufacturing revenue in2033; wafer sales only, no full-chip resale values and no additional packaging revenue. All assumed incremental to existing host services and packaging allowances.
cohort_diagnostic_policy.funding: Fully incremental owned capacity and WC equal next-year revenue divided by turnover, paid one year ahead of use. D&A replacement is funded: physical capex plus WC use equals D&A plus increase in required net operating capital. No free opening asset, customer advances, new subsidy, or incremental minority financing. EBIT includes all direct/variable costs and ongoing incremental customer-support R&D; shared process R&D remains paid in host.
cohort_diagnostic_policy.negative_tax_treatment: Immediate group tax relief on incremental losses, conditional on host profitable tax capacity; favorable to bull.
cohort_diagnostic_policy.rate_limit: Uniform diagnostic rates, not edits to parent rate policy; compare incremental values at consistent parent rate only.
cohort_diagnostic_policy.horizon: Explicit2027–2040 then3%nominal perpetual growth; continuing net capital funded one year ahead.

shared_capacity_sensitivity_policy.chronology: Chosen after fully funded unit values were seen. It tests an economic boundary, not a fitted preferred forecast.
shared_capacity_sensitivity_policy.rule: Credit only this fraction of incremental net capital paid during2027–2032, representing capacity already paid inside the host model and not required by host production. Replacement investment remains included through EBIT/D&A offset and all growth investment from2033 onward is fully paid. The100%case is an algebraic upper bound, not feasible capacity established by sources.
constraints: No internal product displacement; if there is displacement subtract lost host owner cash.
No incremental minority claim for use of partner-owned assets; if incurred, subtract it.
No positive residual/sale value for the same capacity in host.
No additional cashflow credit for already-paid shared process R&D.
shared_capacity_sensitivity_policy.stage_failure_diagnostic: If a new program fails after cashflows through2027 or2029, cease all subsequent revenue and incremental investment; assume zero salvage, with tax relief as original. These are stage-cost illustrations, not probability estimates or evidence that all commitments can be canceled at that stage.
shared_capacity_sensitivity_policy.probability_formula: With success value S and failure value F, risk-neutral arithmetic expected PV = p*S+(1-p)*F. To cover incremental gap G, p=(G-F)/(S-F); p>1 impossible for that pair. Do not use physical probability plus arbitrary risk discount as a uniquely identified fair value.

growth_duration_sensitivity_policy.chronology: Selected after earlier funded-cohort and reuse outputs. No revenue level or probability changed.
growth_duration_sensitivity_policy.unchanged: Original2027–2033ramp, all operating margins, taxes, timing, incremental net capital turnover, shares, and discount-rate controls. No free new growth capital.
growth_duration_sensitivity_policy.scope: Two mature margin/turnover cases plus initial-capital reuse0/50/100% diagnostics. Broad platform growth requires further programs and follow-on nodes, with paid development costs within the assumed margins; no claim that the named Socionext or Fortinet program grows10%forever.

economic_adjudication.strongest_bull: PremiumCPUvalue/content plus profitableexternallysoldpackaging improve cashreturns; brownfieldreuse and betteryields reduce capitalneeded per incremental sale; credible18A/14Aexecution and genuinecustomerdesigns allow long-termrisk todecline. These are correlated mechanisms, so a coherent joint recovery case can overturn the qualifiedshort even if no singlewaferdeal fills the centralPVgap.
economic_adjudication.no_binding_contract_gate: We do not require signed minimums for every forecast dollar. Prospective product scope, likelylaunchwindow, customerscale, capacityandfunding can justify an expectedprogram forecast before definitivevolumes. Currentevidence improves likelihood of progress but does not identify exactadditionalcash above the strongexistingcase.
economic_adjudication.why_cohort_is_not_a_forecast: Revenue ramps, margins, turnover and programsize are explicitdiagnostic assumptions.30%/0.8and40%/1.0 are economicallyplausible probes; neither is a source-measuredIntelmerchant-fabunit-economics estimate. Namedcustomers are not assigned fictitious10Bbudgets.
economic_adjudication.growth_duration: Anewmerchantplatform need not stopgrowing at3%in2033. Additional10%growththrough2040 test addresses that objection with reinvestmentfullypaid. It stillrequiresfurther programwins and recurringnodeinvestment.
economic_adjudication.marginal_investment: Anexistingemptycleanroom is not qualifiedfreecapacity. Currenttools, yields, minimumvolumes, subcontractors, inventory and internalproductopportunitycost matter. Fullinitialreuse is an upperbound, not an adopted forecast.
economic_adjudication.probability: No80/90%successprobability is identified from these facts. Break-evenprobabilities in output are algebraic sensitivity thresholds, not Bayesianposteriors or calibrated physicalprobabilities.
economic_adjudication.decision_relevance: Externalwaferoption is real and can matter by several dollars/share in an optimisticfundedplatformcase, especiallynear the jointrecovery boundary. It does not independently prove theprice cheap or rescue the oldcentral78Bvaluegap. The biggerissue for a high-convictionshort remains whether the chosen persistentasset-risk and matureoperatingpolicy describe the mostlikelyoutcome.

new_multiyear_capital_benchmark.result: TSMC 2020→2025 / 2021→2025 / 2022→2025 revenue increase divided by cumulative net fixed cash investment plus trade WC is 0.932 / 1.046 / 1.091. Trough-ended windows are roughly 0.50. Customer-funding neutralization leaves the longer 2025-ended broad metrics near 1.07–1.08.
new_multiyear_capital_benchmark.effect: This adds support for the existing 1.0 favorable case and stops us dismissing it as unrealistic. It does not estimate Intel expected turnover or a probability distribution. TSMC 2021→2025 revenue rose about 140% while wafer shipments rose about 6%, showing large technology/mix/pricing and packaging effects.
new_multiyear_capital_benchmark.new_vs_existing: Existing research had the single 2025 cash-capex/DA observations and earlier Intel 2018–2020 diagnostic; these new consistent 3–5-year TSMC flow/WC windows were not previously reconstructed.

new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.title: Architectural Implications of Agentic AI Workflows
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.authors_affiliations: University of Texas at Austin and Microsoft Azure
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.design: 24-hour Azure production trace plus four controlled open-source frameworks on 96-core AMD EPYC and eight A100 GPUs. Preprint, not a market forecast.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.bull_finding: CPU scheduling, orchestration and tool work repeatedly enter the critical path, supporting real additional CPU importance as agents scale.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.boundary: Bursty work also leaves idle capacity. Role-aware pooling cuts tool CPU work by 25–46% in tested settings without material completion loss; this is measured software efficiency, not a 46% cut to global chip demand.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.implication: Do not convert latency fractions, agent counts or a universal CPU:GPU ratio directly into processor revenue. Physical demand depends on tasks per agent, CPU-seconds/task after optimization, average occupancy, performance per socket and supplier share. Efficiency can also make agents cheaper and expand usage.

new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.title: Towards Understanding, Analyzing, and Optimizing Agentic AI Execution: A CPU-Centric Perspective
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.authors_affiliations: Georgia Tech and Intel; not fully independent of the issuer
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.design: Five tool/agent workload classes, on Intel GNR plus Blackwell RTX-Pro and NVIDIA Grace/H200 systems; smaller models up to 32B parameters.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.bull_finding: CPU tool execution and memory/scheduling can dominate the critical path as GPU inference accelerates.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.boundary: Results vary greatly by task. The web task uses a CPU lexical summarizer by design; numerical fractions do not describe the whole agent market. COMB and MAS scheduling improve system performance on the same hardware.
new_CPU_architecture_primary_research.implication: Supports the causal role of CPUs, not a specific Intel share, ASP or 2030 unit forecast.

final_adjudication.thesis_effect: Reject a high-confidence absolute short or a guarantee of competition success. Qualified valuation and required-return skepticism remain defensible, but a source-consistent joint bull case is close to or above the quote without absurd inputs.
final_adjudication.capital: Specific pre-AI windows yield 0.664 and 0.733; the 2016–19 trough yields 0.357; selected windows ending in 2025 yield 0.932–1.091. These are cycle/mix examples, not causal calibration of Intel capital productivity.
final_adjudication.CPU: Production studies and buyer announcements establish CPU importance. Scheduling, rebound, pricing, share, workload mix and future Intel products prevent direct conversion to unit or ASP forecasts.
final_adjudication.wafer: A real option with shared R&D and brownfield benefits, but overlap, opportunity cost and capital must be explicit. The fully funded favorable platform plus a maturing-risk host changes $53.77 to $57.97, demonstrating materiality.
final_adjudication.presentation: Root revised the working PDF during the hour; the original frozen model remains unchanged. This child did not modify the PDF. Parent corrected-rate and weak-demand analyses determine the adopted valuation.
